Withdrawn

7,282 arXiv papers whose comment says withdrawn, one square each, from 1992 to 2026, in the order of their last version. Touch a square to read the notice.

  • said nothing else · 1,198
  • gave a reason that is not an error · 3,431
  • named an error, not where · 1,151
  • named an error and where it is · 940
  • withdrawn by the archive's administrators · 562
  • someone else is named as having noticed

Each colour is a machine's reading of one sentence, by rules fixed before the sentences were fetched, and checked against a hand reading of sixty of them; it is wrong on a few in every sixty. The squares that say nothing stop in 2013 and 2014, while the archive's help page asked for a reason both before and after. Metadata from the arXiv API, CC0, harvested 2026-10-04. Evidence, rules and counts: the directory this page lives in.
